main_text.p: Salarium] Annuum,Suet. Annona,Voget. Stipendium militare, Cic.
Salax] Priapo, passere salacior. Satyrium bibit. Satyrias, vid. Lascivus.
Salebra] Iniquitas loci, Liv. Inæquabilis locus, Var.
Salebrosus] Confragosus, iniquus locus, Liv. Fragosus, Lucr. Fragosa oratio, Quint. Gradatus, Plin. Inæqualis mensa, Mart. Inæquabilis, Var.
Salinæ] Salifodinæ, & Salis fodinæ, Vitr. Areæ salinariæ, Id. Montes salis nativi, Plin. Optimi condimenti promptuarium.
Salire] Sallire, Sisen. Aspergere sale, Col. Aspergere salem carnibus, Plin.
Saliva] Sputum salsum, tenue, Lucr. Pituita tenuis, Celf.
Salsamentum] Muriatica salsa, Plaut. Salsura, Col. Pabulum salsurae, Id.
Salsugo] Salsilago, Plin. Salsitudo aquae, Vitr. Muria. Aqua salsa, Col. Eliquamen salsamentorum, Colvin.
Salsus] Sallior, Solin. Præsulsus, Col. Salmacidus, Plin. Salmacia aqua, Scal.
Saltare] Saltitare, Macrob. Saltu ferri, Virg. Dare saltum, Ovid. Uti saltu, Cic. Saliendo se exercere, Plaut. Argutari pedibus, Non. Persultare per campos, Lucr. campos, Tac. Insultare solo, Virg.
Saltatio] Saltatus, Liv. Intempestivi convivii comes, vid. Chorea.
Saltatorius] Saltatorius ludus, Macr. Saltuaris: saltuares insulæ, Plin.

Saltem] Saltim, Priscian. Vel: si nullo alio pacto, vel fœnore, Ter. Minimùm, Var. Adero, sin, utique postridiè. Velim possis antè, sin minùs, utique simul. Certè. Ut levissimè dicam. Sin minùs, at, Cic. Non amplius unam noctem, Virg. Minimè, Col. Vix saltem, Quint. Tamen. Quin dicas, quicquid est, Ter.
Saltus, lusus] Ascoliasmus, Empusæ ludus, Iun. Staticulus, Plaut.

page.notes: Page is clear; a few words in the faint show-through from the reverse side were ignored. Some words such as "Satyrium" and "Salsamentum" are printed as shown; "Saltus," catchword is partly faint. "Liv." and "Lucr." abbreviations kept as printed.
